reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the list price of the version before it
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), cuts AS (
  -- one row per price cut from 1 February to 31 March 2025, with the Monday of its week
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur < prev_price
    AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
), promo_weeks AS (
  -- one row per product and week that shares a day with one of its promotions
  SELECT DISTINCT pp.product_id, w.week_start
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
  JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND w.week_start <= p.end_date AND w.week_start + INTERVAL 6 DAY >= p.start_date
), averages AS (
  -- one row per price cut: its average weekly units before and after, promotion weeks left out
  SELECT c.product_id, c.valid_from,
    AVG(CASE WHEN w.week_start < c.change_week AND pw.product_id IS NULL THEN w.units END) AS avg_before,
    AVG(CASE WHEN w.week_start > c.change_week AND pw.product_id IS NULL THEN w.units END) AS avg_after
  FROM cuts c
  JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = c.product_id
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN c.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND c.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY
  LEFT JOIN promo_weeks pw ON pw.product_id = w.product_id AND pw.week_start = w.week_start
  GROUP BY c.product_id, c.valid_from
)
SELECT product_id, valid_from, ROUND(100.0 * (avg_after - avg_before) / NULLIF(avg_before, 0), 1) AS pct_change
FROM averages

  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur < prev_price AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
), weeks AS (
  -- one row per price cut and week of its two windows that is not a promotion week
  SELECT c.product_id, c.valid_from, c.change_week, w.week_start, w.units
  FROM cuts c
  JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = c.product_id
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN c.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND c.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM promotion_products pp JOIN promotions p ON p.promo_id = pp.promo_id
    WHERE pp.product_id = w.product_id AND p.start_date <= w.week_start + INTERVAL 6 DAY AND p.end_date >= w.week_start)
), averages AS (
  -- one row per price cut that keeps a week: its averages before and after
  SELECT product_id, valid_from,
    AVG(units) FILTER (WHERE week_start < change_week) AS avg_before,
    AVG(units) FILTER (WHERE week_start > change_week) AS avg_after
  FROM weeks
  GROUP BY product_id, valid_from
)
SELECT c.product_id, c.valid_from, ROUND(100.0 * (a.avg_after - a.avg_before) / NULLIF(a.avg_before, 0), 1) AS pct_change
FROM cuts c
LEFT JOIN averages a ON a.product_id = c.product_id AND a.valid_from = c.valid_from

solver.query:
WITH versions AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), cuts AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur < prev_price AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
), wk AS (
  SELECT r.product_id, r.valid_from,
    CASE WHEN w.week_start < r.change_week THEN 'b' ELSE 'a' END AS side, w.units,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM promotion_products pp JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = pp.promo_id
      WHERE pp.product_id = r.product_id AND pr.start_date <= CAST(w.week_start + INTERVAL 6 DAY AS DATE)
        AND pr.end_date >= w.week_start) AS is_promo
  FROM cuts r JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = r.product_id
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN CAST(r.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AS DATE) AND CAST(r.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY AS DATE)
    AND w.week_start <> r.change_week
), agg AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from,
    SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'b' AND NOT is_promo THEN units END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN side = 'b' AND NOT is_promo THEN 1 END), 0) AS avg_units_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'a' AND NOT is_promo THEN units END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN side = 'a' AND NOT is_promo THEN 1 END), 0) AS avg_units_after
  FROM wk GROUP BY product_id, valid_from
)
SELECT product_id, valid_from,
  CASE WHEN avg_units_before IS NULL OR avg_units_before = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (avg_units_after - avg_units_before) / avg_units_before, 1) END AS pct_change
FROM agg
